Description: Use when someone asks to be onboarded, says "I'm new here" or "onboard me", wants "explain how this works" or "how does our AI system work", or shows confusion about MCP/Skills while asking a task question. Interactive training session for new employees.
Purpose: A short, friendly walkthrough that explains how Claude, MCP, and skills fit together — the fastest way to get oriented if you're brand new.
When to Use: Say things like “I'm new here,” “onboard me,” or “explain how this works” — or just ask when you're confused about MCP or skills.
Where to Use: Anywhere, for anyone starting out — developers, PMs, designers, support, sales, or data roles.
Input Required: Just answer two quick questions: your role, and whether you've used AI tools like this before. Nothing else needed.
Expected Output: A short interactive lesson, right in the chat. If you want, it can also save you a one-page cheat sheet and a completion summary — but only after you say yes. At the end, it'll also mention /new-joinee as an optional next step if you want deeper, role-specific onboarding.
Execution Steps:
1. Check prior progress and establish role and experience.
2. Explain Data, MCP, Claude plus Skills, and Output.
3. Demonstrate the workflow and optionally inspect project files.
4. Check comprehension and reteach gaps.
5. Personalize next steps and save approved onboarding outputs.
Business Rules: Only write approved outputs under onboarding-output; never expose credentials or modify project configuration; do not invent company facts; inspect project files only when the learner opts in.
Tool Required: Claude; file reading; file writing only for approved saves
